phrases.arabic: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ،
phrases.english: 1.Praise belongs to God, who created night and day through His strength,

phrases.arabic: وَمَيَّزَ بَيْنَهُمَا بِقُدْرَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 2.set them apart through His power,

phrases.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً، وَأَمَداً مَمْدُوداً ،
phrases.english: 3.and appointed for each a determined limit and a drawn-out period.

phrases.arabic: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ،
phrases.english: 4.He makes each of the two enter into its companion,

phrases.arabic: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِير مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ
phrases.english: 5.and makes its companion enter into it, as an ordainment from Him for His servants

phrases.arabic: فِيمَا يَغْـذُوهُمْ بِـهِ وَيُنْشئُهُمْ عَلَيْـهِ،
phrases.english: 6.in that through which He feeds them and with which He makes them grow.

phrases.arabic: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْـلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيْهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ،
phrases.english: 7.He created for them the night, "that they might rest in it" (10:67) from tiring movements

phrases.arabic: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ،
phrases.english: 8.and wearisome exertions and He made it a garment for them that they might be clothed in its ease and its sleep,

phrases.arabic: فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ جَمَاماً وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
phrases.english: 9.that it might be for them refreshment and strength, that they might reach therein pleasure and passion.

phrases.arabic: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهارَ مُبْصِراً لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
phrases.english: 10.He created for them the daytime, "giving sight, that they might seek within it of His bounty" (ref. 17:12)

phrases.arabic: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا  إلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ،
phrases.english: 11.find the means to His provision, and roam freely in His earth,

phrases.arabic: طَلَباً لِمَا فِيـهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ،
phrases.english: 12.searching for that through which to attain the immediate in their life in this world

phrases.arabic: وَدَرَكُ الاجِلِ فِيْ اُخْراهُمْ. بِكُلِّ ذلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأنَهُمْ،
phrases.english: 13.and to achieve the deferred in their life to come. Through all of this He sets right their situation,

phrases.arabic: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِـهِ،
phrases.english: 14.tries their records, and watches their state in the times for obeying Him,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنَازِلِ فُـرُوضِهِ وَمَوَاقِعِ أَحْكَامِهِ
phrases.english: 15.the waystations of His obligations, and the places of His ordinances,

phrases.arabic: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
phrases.english: 16.that He may repay those who do evil with what they have done and repay those who do good with goodness.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَافَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الإصْبَاحِ،
phrases.english: 17.O God, to You belongs praise for the sky You hast split into dawn for us,

phrases.arabic: وَمَتَّعْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ ضَوْءِ النَّهَارِ،
phrases.english: 18.giving us to enjoy thereby the brightness of daytime,

phrases.arabic: وَبَصَّرْتَنَا مِنْ مَطَالِبِ الاقْوَاتِ،
phrases.english: 19.showing us sought-after nourishments,

phrases.arabic: وَوَقَيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنْ طَوارِقِ الآفاتِ.
phrases.english: 20.and protecting us from the striking of blights.

phrases.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الاَشْياءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ:
phrases.english: 21.In the morning we and all things, every one, rise for You,

phrases.arabic: سَمَاؤُها وَأَرْضُهَا وَمَا بَثَثْتَ
phrases.english: 22.the heaven and the earth and what You hast scattered

phrases.arabic: فِي كُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ
phrases.english: 23.in each, the still and the moving, the resident

phrases.arabic: وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلا فِي الْهَواءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرى
phrases.english: 24.and the journeying, what towers up in the air and what hides under the ground.

phrases.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا فِي قَبْضَتِكَ
phrases.english: 25.We rise in the morning in Your grasp:

phrases.arabic: يَحْوِينَا مُلْكُكَ وَسُلْطَانُكَ وَتَضُمُّنَا مَشِيَّتُكَ،
phrases.english: 26.Your kingdom and authority contain us and Your will embraces us.

phrases.arabic: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِيْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
phrases.english: 27.We move about by Your command and turn this way and that through Your governing.

phrases.arabic: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الامْرِ إلاّ مَا قَضَيْتَ
phrases.english: 28.We own nothing of the affair except what You hast decreed

phrases.arabic: وَلا مِنَ الْخَيْـرِ إلا مَـا أَعْطَيْتَ.
phrases.english: 29.and nothing of the good except what You hast given.

phrases.arabic: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ ،
phrases.english: 30.This is a fresh, new day, over us a ready witness.

phrases.arabic: إنْ أحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْد، وَإِنْ أسَأنا فارَقَنا بِذَمّ
phrases.english: 31.If we do good, it will take leave from us with praise, and if we do evil, it will part from us in blame.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَد وَآلِـهِ
phrases.english: 32.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَارْزُقْنَـا حُسْنَ مُصَاحَبَتِهِ وَاعْصِمْنَا
phrases.english: 33.provide us with the day's good companionship and preserve us

phrases.arabic: مِنْ سُوْءِ مُفَارَقَتِهِ بِارْتِكَابِ جَرِيرَة،
phrases.english: 34.against parting from it badly by doing a misdeed

phrases.arabic: أَوِ اقْتِرَافِ صَغِيرَة أوْ كَبِيرَة.
phrases.english: 35.or committing a sin, whether small or great!

phrases.arabic: وَأجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَناتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ.
phrases.english: 36.Make our good deeds within it plentiful empty us therein of evil deeds,

phrases.arabic: وَامْلا لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْداً وَشُكْراً وَأجْراً وَذُخْراً وَفَضْلاً وَإحْسَاناً.
phrases.english: 37.and fill what lies between its two sides for us with praise and thanksgiving, wages and stores, bounty and beneficence!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا،
phrases.english: 38.O God, ease our burden on the Noble Writers,

phrases.arabic: وَامْلا لَنَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِنَا صَحَائِفَنَا.
phrases.english: 39.fill our pages for us with our good deeds,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا عِنْدَهُمْ بِسُوءِ أَعْمَالِنَا.
phrases.english: 40.and degrade us not before them with our evil works!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظّاً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ،
phrases.english: 41.O God, appoint for us in each of the day's hours a share from Your servants,

phrases.arabic: وَنَصِيباً مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْق مِنْ  مَلائِكَتِكَ
phrases.english: 42.a portion of giving thanks to You, and a truthful witness among Your angels!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهَّمَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ،
phrases.english: 43.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أيْمَانِنَا  وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا،
phrases.english: 44.and safeguard us from before us and behind us, from our right hands and our left hands

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ نَوَاحِيْنَا حِفْظاً عَاصِماً مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
phrases.english: 45.and from all our directions, a safeguarding that will preserve from disobeying You,

phrases.arabic: هَادِياً إلَى طَاعَتِكَ مُسْتَعْمِلاً لِمَحَبَّتِكَ.
phrases.english: 46.guide to obeying You, and be employed for Your love!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 47.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هذا ولَيْلَتِنَا هذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أيّامِنَا
phrases.english: 48.and give us success in this day of ours, this night of ours, and in all our days,

phrases.arabic: لاسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْـرَانِ الشَرِّ وَشُكْـرِ ألنِّعَمِ
phrases.english: 49.to employ the good, stay away from the evil, give thanks for favours,

phrases.arabic: وَاتّبَـاعِ السُّنَنِ وَمُجَانَبَةِ البِدَعِ
phrases.english: 50.follow the Sunna's norms, avoid innovations,

phrases.arabic: وَالأمْرِ بِـالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهيِ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ
phrases.english: 51.enjoin good behaviour, forbid the disapproved,

phrases.arabic: وَحِياطَةِ الإسْلاَمِ وَانْتِقَاصِ الْبَاطِلِ وَإذْلالِهِ
phrases.english: 52.defend Islam, diminish falsehood and abase it,

phrases.arabic: وَنُصْرَةِ الْحَقِّ وَإعْزَازِهِ ، وَإرْشَادِ الضَّالِّ ،
phrases.english: 53.help the truth and exalt it, guide the misguided,

phrases.arabic: وَمُعَاوَنَةِ الضَّعِيفِ وَإدْرَاكِ اللَّهِيْفِ.
phrases.english: 54.assist the weak, and reach out to the troubled!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد  وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 55.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْهُ أيْمَنَ يَوْم عَهِدْنَاهُ ،
phrases.english: 56.and make this the most fortunate day we have known,

phrases.arabic: وَأَفْضَلَ صَاحِب صَحِبْنَاهُ ،
phrases.english: 57.the most excellent companion we have accompanied,

phrases.arabic: وَخَيْرَ وَقْت ظَلِلْنَا فِيْهِ.
phrases.english: 58.and the best time in which we have lingered!

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْـلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ
phrases.english: 59.Place us among the most satisfied of all Your creatures whom night and day have passed by,

phrases.arabic: وأَشْكَـرَهُمْ لِمَا أوْلَيْتَ مِنْ نِعَمِكَ
phrases.english: 60.the most thankful of them for the favours You hast done,

phrases.arabic: وَأقْوَمَهُمْ بِمَـا شَرَعْتَ مِنْ شَرَائِعِكَ ،
phrases.english: 61.the firmest of them in the laws You hast set down in the Shari'a,

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْقَفَهُمْ عَمَّا حَذَّرْتَ مِنْ نَهْيِكَ.
phrases.english: 62.and the most unyielding of them toward the prohibited acts against which You hast cautioned!

phrases.arabic: اللَهُمَّ إنِّي اشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيداً وَاُشْهِدُ سَمَاءكَ وَأَرْضَكَ
phrases.english: 63.O God, I call You to witness - and You art sufficient witness - and I call Your heaven and Your earth to witness

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُما مِنْ مَلائِكَتِـكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا ،
phrases.english: 64.and Your angels and Your other creatures who inhabit them in this my day,

phrases.arabic: وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا ،
phrases.english: 65.this my hour, this my night, and this my resting place,

phrases.arabic: أنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أنْتَ اللهُ الِذَّي
phrases.english: 66.that I bear witness that You art God,

phrases.arabic: لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِـالْقِسْطِ ،
phrases.english: 67.other than whom there is no god, Upholding justice,

phrases.arabic: عَدْلٌ فِي الْحُكْم ، رَؤُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ ،
phrases.english: 68.Equitable in judgement, "Clement to the servants" (2:207),

phrases.arabic: مَالِكُ المُلْكِ رَحِيمٌ بِالْخَلْقِ ،
phrases.english: 69."Master of the kingdom" (3:26), Compassionate to the creatures,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
phrases.english: 70.and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger, Your chosen from among Your creatures.

phrases.arabic: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بالنُّصْحِ لاُِمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
phrases.english: 71.You didst charge him with Your message and he delivered it; You didst command him to counsel his community and he counselled it.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ أكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
phrases.english: 72.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household more than You hast blessed any of Your creatures!

phrases.arabic: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
phrases.english: 73.Give him for our sake the best You hast given any of Your servants,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيائِـكَ  عَنْ أمَّتِهِ.
phrases.english: 74.and repay him on our behalf better and more generously than You hast repaid any of Your prophets on behalf of his community!

phrases.arabic: إنَّـكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَـافِر لِلْعَظِيمِ ،
phrases.english: 75.You art All-kind with immensity, the Forgiver of the great,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ مِنْ كُلِّ رَحِيم ،
phrases.english: 76.and You art more merciful than every possessor of mercy!

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 77.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ الأَخْيَارِ الانْجَبِينَ.
phrases.english: 78.the good, the pure, the chosen, the most distinguished!
